perplexity.name: Perplexity AI
perplexity.system_prompt: You have two capabilities: (1) NATIVE WEB SEARCH for research, facts, and current information - use this automatically for questions and cite sources as markdown links. (2) EXTERNAL TOOLS for file operations, shell commands, and editing - when tools are available and the user asks to DO something (cd, ls, edit, fix, run, create, analyze), execute the appropriate tool immediately instead of explaining how. For actions: act first, report results briefly. For questions: search and cite. Never tell the user to do manually what a tool can do.

Engine ModelProfile entry retained (`*/qwen3-coder-480b*` in engine/model_profiles.py) so users with paid NIM access can re-add this model to their own config and get the right Tier S characteristics.

Healthy: qwen3.5-122b-a10b 77.4%, qwen3-next-80b-thinking 76.6%, qwen3-next-80b-instruct 68.3%. qwen3-coder-480b excluded from this curated set as of 2026-05-02 — two free-tier runs both scored 19.0% with the same low-tool-call/short-duration contamination signature that healthy peers don't share (9-11 calls in 75-86s vs 74-89 calls in 197-1836s). nvidia.__comment_known_issues: 1) Free-tier hangs on long agentic_tool_loops tests for some models (mistral-large-3, llama-3.3-nemotron). 2) llama-4-maverick is regionally restricted ('NIM unavailable in your location' from EU). 3) qwen2.5-coder-32b returns HTTP 400 'Tool use has not been enabled' — set tool_calling.mode='prompt_based' for that model.

local.system_prompt:
You are a coding assistant running locally as Qwen3-4B on an RTX 3050 via vLLM.

Rules:
1. ALWAYS output a visible text response — never reply with silence. After every tool call or failure, write at least one sentence.
2. When a tool fails or returns an error, explicitly say so: 'The tool failed: <reason>. I will try X instead.'
3. For code tasks: output the complete, correct solution — do not truncate
4. For apply+verify tasks: call apply_patch first, then read_file to confirm the change was applied
5. Prefer apply_patch over write_file for existing files
6. Use read_file instead of cat/shell commands for reading
7. Do NOT re-read a file you already read unless the content changed

execution.__comment: ADR 0010/0011 third config axis: how each execution surface runs. execution.run.* governs the one-off tier (/run family + /v1/oneshot facade). web_search: expose the web_search tool loop to oneshot (ADR 0009 enrichment, default off). grounding: provider-NATIVE search on oneshot (supersedes tools.web_search.oneshot_grounding; dual-read keeps the legacy key working). collect (U4): how /run + /task results reach the active session — auto (always auto-merge on completion) | yes (held until the Collect button/verb finalizes+merges; default) | no (collect disabled: button greyed, verb warns, result stays on the run record).
execution.__comment_task: v1.19.1 BREAKING (ADR 0010): the tool-capable /v1/agent/task tier moved here wholesale from tools.agent.* — NO dual-read, the legacy keys are gone. enabled (was task_tier_enabled), sandbox (was tools.agent.sandbox), consent.spawn_consent, consent.consent_ttl_s, budgets.result_retention_s. Run /doctor for the full old->new mapping.

overrides.read_file: Read the complete contents of a file
overrides.write_file: Create or overwrite a file with new content
overrides.edit_file: Make precise edits to existing files using search/replace
overrides.list_directory: List all files and directories in a path

ollama.list_directory: Show all files in a folder

web_search.__comment_egress: ADR 0009 §2 per-tool egress baseline: hosts merged into any run that GRANTS this tool (task tier + oneshot facade). Supersedes task_default_allow (legacy, dual-read).

get_weather.__comment_egress: ADR 0009 §2 (retires Item 52): the weather chain's full superset — wttr.in + Open-Meteo (key-free) + premium search hosts (used only when keyed). Config-driven so granted weather runs work on every tier.
